name: timeline.layout
title: Timeline layout
summary: Lay scenes out from voice-over lines, or cut them to a song's form (scenes in beats or bars, or until bar N): cue times, scene lengths, optional beat snapping, music markers, named times and a grid report. Writes timeline.json and dialogue-clips.json.
description: A pure layout helper with two ways in. Voice first: each scene is as long as its lines plus the lead, gaps and tail you ask for (all zero by default, nothing snapped), or a fixed duration_s. Audio lines are measured at their speech end (Piper leaves trailing silence), not their file length. Music first, when the song is made before the picture: write the song's form as the grid (bpm, beats_per_bar, and offset_s = where bar 0 falls), give each scene its length in beats or bars, or let it run until a time ("bar:8", "beat:30" or seconds), then check grid_report in the result: every scene end with its time, its beat and whether it is on a beat. The report is information only; nothing is snapped or refused. Lines in such a scene keep their cues; when they need longer than the scene, a warning gives the overrun and the length is kept. The two ways mix freely, scene by scene. Optional beat snapping, markers that align the music grid to a scene (the music_offset_s / beatOffset), named times, and a per-frame voice envelope are available when you want them. It never renders or mixes anything; it only computes numbers.

defaults.description: Layout defaults for every scene. All neutral (0, no snapping) unless set.

lead_s.description: Seconds from the scene start to the first line (default 0).

gap_s.description: Seconds between two lines when a line sets no pause_s (default 0).

tail_s.description: Seconds after the last line before the scene ends (default 0).

snap_beats.description: Round every scene length up to a multiple of this many beats (needs grid). null = no snapping (default).

grid.description: Musical grid: the song's form. Required for snap_beats, beats, bars, markers and bar:/beat: times (in times and until). When given, the result has grid_report.

offset_s.description: Seconds from 0 to bar 0 (default 0). bar:/beat: times, beats/bars scenes and grid_report all count from here.

preset.description: Named layout preset from presets/timeline/ (for example voice-driven-classic), merged under this request.

scenes.description: Scenes in playback order; each starts where the previous one ends.

id.description: Scene id (letters, digits, _ or -), used by times and markers.

duration_s.description: Fixed scene length in seconds. Overrides the line-driven length and is used exactly (not snapped). Set at most one of duration_s, beats, bars and until.

beats.description: Scene length in beats of grid (needs grid), used exactly: not snapped, min_s ignored. Overrides the line-driven length; lines that need longer give a warning and the length is kept. Set at most one of duration_s, beats, bars and until.

bars.description: Scene length in bars of grid (one bar = beats_per_bar beats; needs grid), used exactly like beats. Set at most one of duration_s, beats, bars and until.

until.description: The scene ends at this time and fills from its start up to it: seconds, or "bar:<n>[+-s]" / "beat:<n>[+-s]" on grid (0-based, counted from grid.offset_s; needs grid). Must be after the scene's start. Lines that need longer give a warning and the end is kept. Set at most one of duration_s, beats, bars and until.

snap_beats.description: Overrides defaults.snap_beats for this scene (null = do not snap this scene).

lines.description: Voice-over lines in order. Omit for an empty scene. In a scene of fixed length (duration_s, beats, bars or until) the cues are laid out the same way, from the scene start.

audio.description: Audio for the line: a workspace path, job:<id>/<output> or pin:<name>. Its speech end (threshold speech_end_threshold_db) sets the cue length.

dur_s.description: Cue length in seconds when there is no audio.

text.description: Caption text, kept in the cue.

who.description: Speaker name, used to group the per-speaker voice envelope.

pause_s.description: Seconds before this line; overrides gap_s for this line (ignored on the first line).

tempo.description: Playback speed of the line (default 1). The cue lasts speech_end / tempo seconds.

speech_end_threshold_db.description: dBFS threshold that marks the end of speech in an audio line (default -40).

markers.description: Named markers: each names the scene it sits on and what the music grid should align to there.

scene.description: Id of the scene this marker sits on.

align.description: What a marker aligns to when it is named by align_to: a bar line (bar), a beat (beat) or nothing (none). Default bar.

align_to.description: Name of the marker whose alignment sets the global music_offset_s (beatOffset). Other markers report their bar index with that offset.

times.description: Named times resolved against the computed timeline, e.g. {"hit": "b#0.end-0.1"}.

envelope.description: Optional per-frame voice loudness for the picture to react to. Only audio lines contribute.

fps.description: Frames per second of the envelope.

normalize.description: peak = scale so the loudest frame is gain; none = raw RMS. Default peak.

per_speaker.description: true = voices keyed by who; false = a single voice array. Default true.

extra.description: Fields copied verbatim into the root of timeline.json (name, size, fps, fonts, poster...).

grid_report.description: Only when grid is given. Where every scene ends on the grid (information only: nothing is snapped or refused).

boundaries.description: One entry per scene, in order: its end, which is the cut into the next scene (the last one is the end of the timeline). The timeline start (0) is not listed.

scene.description: Id of the scene that ends here.

time.description: Seconds (the next scene's start, or total).

beat.description: Position in beats from grid.offset_s (beat 0 = bar 0); bar = beat / beats_per_bar.

on_beat.description: true when within 0.5 ms of a beat.

off_grid.description: How many boundaries are not on a beat.

warnings.description: Facts worth a look: lines that need longer than a beats, bars or until scene (with the overrun), and one summary when a layout cut to the grid has scene ends off the beat grid. Empty when there is nothing to say.

examples.title: Two scenes from explicit line durations, all defaults neutral
Snap a 3 s scene up to a 2 s bar (4 beats at 120 bpm)
Music first: a 132 bpm 4/4 song whose bar 0 falls at 0.5 s, cut in bars and beats and until bar 9; grid_report shows every cut on a beat
A drop marker aligns the music grid and a named time points at a cue end
A cue measured from a WAV's speech end, with a per-speaker voice envelope
